Loading Button

Loading buttons provide visual feedback during asynchronous operations. They display a spinner animation and are disabled while the action is in progress.

Basic

A button with a loading spinner. Click the button to see the interactive demo.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary loading-btn-demo">
    <svg class="zak-btn-spinner" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="31.4 31.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>
    Click to Load
</button>

JavaScript

Use JavaScript to toggle the loading state dynamically.

HTML
// Basic loading button toggle
document.querySelectorAll('.loading-btn-demo').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.classList.add('zak-btn-loading');
        this.disabled = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.classList.remove('zak-btn-loading');
            this.disabled = false;
        }, 2000);
    });
});

// Manual loading control
function setButtonLoading(button, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        button.classList.add('zak-btn-loading');
        button.disabled = true;
        button.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    } else {
        button.classList.remove('zak-btn-loading');
        button.disabled = false;
        button.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
    }
}

// Usage with async/await
document.querySelector('#submit-btn').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    setButtonLoading(this, true);
    try {
        await saveData();
        // Success feedback
    } catch (error) {
        // Error feedback
    } finally {
        setButtonLoading(this, false);
    }
});

CSS

HTML
/* Loading Button States */
.zak-btn-loading {
    position: relative;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.zak-btn-loading .zak-btn-spinner {
    animation: zak-spin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

.zak-btn-loading .zak-btn-spinner {
    width: 1em;
    height: 1em;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
}

/* Spinner Animation */
@keyframes zak-spin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

Accessibility

  • Always set disabled on the button during loading to prevent multiple submissions.
  • Add aria-busy="true" during loading to announce the busy state to screen readers.
  • Keep the button text meaningful so screen readers announce what action is being processed.
  • Reset the button text and state when the operation completes.
HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" aria-busy="true" disabled>
    <svg class="zak-btn-spinner" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    Saving...
</button>
